description: This PHP class 'Crc32ValidatingParser' decorates a parser to validate the 'x-amz-crc32' header for AWS responses, ensuring data integrity by verifying the checksum.

classes.name: Crc32ValidatingParser
classes.description: A decorator class for parser that adds CRC32 integrity check validation on AWS responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a parser callable to wrap.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Validates the 'x-amz-crc32' header against the computed checksum; throws an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a member from a stream to the wrapped parser.
